title: Recent advances in asymmetric bimetallic catalysis
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00413F, Review Article
Fang Wei, Jialin Qi, Xiangqing Jia, Zhenghu Xu
This review summarizes recent significant advances in the field, including three different modes: dual metal Lewis acid catalysis, transition-metal/metal Lewis acid catalysis, and dual transition-metal catalysis, aiming to inspire further progress.
